findings.description: The header comment still says the full harness set runs when "any file under scripts/, tests/ or .github/workflows/" changes, but line 30 now only matches `scripts/* | tests/scripts/* | tests/hooks/* | .github/workflows/*`, so a change like `tests/unit/test_x.py` (the new test case) runs no harness. Change it to "scripts/, tests/scripts/, tests/hooks/ or .github/workflows/".

process_issues.description: `git show origin/ci/review-metrics:records/46144549165.json` failed in the Bash sandbox (`bwrap: Can't get type of source .../.git/config.worktree.lock: No such file or directory`). The prior round's importants were read from its posted review body instead (via `gh pr view 73 --json reviews`), which says "No blocking issues found", so prior_importants is empty.
